mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN analysis_task st ON st.id = ( SELECT st0.id FROM analysis_task st0 WHERE st0.case_id = c.id AND st0.task_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' ORDER BY st0.updated_at DESC, st0.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

WHERE c.assigned_doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND c.status != 'DELETED'
AND c.workflow_status = #{criteria.workflowStatus}
AND st.id IS NULL
AND (st.id IS NULL OR st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING','FAILED'))
AND st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING')
AND st.status = 'FAILED' AND st.status = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patientCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS caseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsegmentedCaseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.id IS NULL OR st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incompleteSegmentationCaseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'SUCCESS' AND (rv.id IS NULL OR rv.status IN ('PENDING','CHANGES_REQUESTED')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReviewCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rv.status = 'APPROVED' AND sr.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReportCount FROM medical_case c
LEFT JOIN analysis_result ar ON ar.task_id = st.id LEFT JOIN analysis_review rv ON rv.result_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN analysis_report sr ON sr.id = ( SELECT sr0.id FROM analysis_report sr0 WHERE sr0.result_id = ar.id AND sr0.status = 'SIGNED' ORDER BY sr0.signed_at DESC, sr0.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.assigned_doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND c.status != 'DELETED'
